{{Top|leg}}
The '''KV609-B engine battery cell''' was produced by [[Keizar-Volvec/Legends|Keizar-Volvec]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The KV609-B allowed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to rapidly refill a portion of their engine power reserve, effectively permitting [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to use boosters for extended periods.
